The '''''Starbound Misfit''''' was a heavily modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] that was owned by the [[Near-Human]] [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lynnori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Lynnori's boyfriend, [[Talandro Starlyte]], purchased the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as a gift for [[Gender/Legends|her]] and had his [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Scizzic]], make some modifications that improved the ship's capabilities. After the modifications, it boasted a much faster [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and heavier armaments than a stock ship of its class. Lynnori enjoyed having the freedom that came with owning her own ship and she used it as often as she could.

==Description==
The ''Starbound Misfit'' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1930 transport/Legends|YT-1930]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. It required a crew of two and could carry up to six passengers. It had [[Foodstuff/Legends|consumables]] good for four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of operation and a cargo bay that could hold 200 [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]]. The ship came equipped with a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]], as well as strong [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. It had a maximum speed of 950 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kmh]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="WHSV" />

[[File:StarboundMisfitInt.png|left|250px]]
The ''Starbound Misfit'' was built around a central saucer with the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] centrally located between the two forward prongs of the ship. The cockpit could fit two crew and up to two passengers. Behind the cockpit was passenger seating and an emergency [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Going clockwise around the ship's central saucer was a weapon storage locker, a [[Holotable/Legends|holotable]] and lounge area, a galley, and a technical station. In the center of the ship was access the top and bottom gunwells as well as the airlock/connection hatch. The two forward prongs held maintenance accesses. Port of the cockpit held the captain's [[Blinking Eyes: Quarters|quarters]] and two passenger or crew cabins. Across from the cabins were a series of storage lockers.<ref name="WHSV" />

The aft of the ship held the [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], and there were engine insulators installed there. On either side of the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were cargo bays that contained freezers. Forward of the cargo bays there was an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] on each side on the exterior of the ship and across the hallway from the pods were secret [[Smuggling compartment/Legends|smuggling compartments]]. After [[Scizzic]]'s modifications the ''Starbound Misfit'' boasted heavier twin fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] than the stock model, an added [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]], as well as a 0.5 Class hyperdrive and a backup Class 10 hyperdrive. The modifications also shortened the length of the ''Starbound Misfit'' from 36.58 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] to 35 meters.<ref name="WHSV" />

==History==
The ''Starbound Misfit'' was purchased for the [[Near-Human]] [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lynnori]] by her boyfriend [[Talandro Starlyte]] and modified by the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] Scizzic as a way to keep Lynnori safer on her travels. She owned the ship during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="WHSV" />

==Owners and operators==
The ''Starbound Misfit'' only had a single owner, the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Near-Human Lynnori. She mostly used the ship for legal shipping operations or carrying passengers, but she was not adverse to the occasional [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] contract. She enjoyed the freedom that came with having her own ship and traveled constantly.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Starbound Misfit'' was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].
